'''Mazzoney's''' was a seedy cantina in the city of [[Selkren]] on the planet [[Demophon]]. Even when the citizens were in a panic to flee the planet before its [[Demophon (star)|sun]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], Mazzoney's remained open as a den of decadence and corruption. [[Mazzoney]] himself tended the bar. The establishment had a reputation for being a place to find information. In case of trouble the cantina was staffed with [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] bouncers. Mazzoney was known to engage in brawls himself, as well.
